resources.string: App events and crashes, without personal data
Could not save the report. Try another folder.

Recording is off by default. The report contains app events and error locations, but no notifications, health data, device addresses, packets or error messages. It is stored privately on your phone and is never sent automatically. Save lets you choose a folder for a copy.
Enable recording before reproducing a problem. Turning it off stops new entries; previously recorded entries remain available. Some system terminations cannot be captured.
